title: LMS Course Completion Momentum
scenario: Identify students who finished a certificate faster than the rolling 3-certificate average of their peers, specifically within a 30-day window.
tableSchema: progress (stu_id INT, lesson_id INT, completion_date DATE), certificates (stu_id INT, issue_date DATE)
hint: Use a CTE to calculate individual duration and a windowed AVG() to determine peer benchmark.
correctQuery: WITH cert_times AS (SELECT stu_id, issue_date, (issue_date - MIN(completion_date) OVER(PARTITION BY stu_id)) as duration FROM certificates JOIN progress USING (stu_id)) SELECT stu_id FROM (SELECT stu_id, duration, AVG(duration) OVER(ORDER BY issue_date ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) as peer_avg FROM cert_times) t WHERE duration < peer_avg;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE progress (stu_id INT, lesson_id INT, completion_date DATE); CREATE TABLE certificates (cert_id INT, stu_id INT, issue_date DATE);
